title: After sunset, Staffelalp
alt: A timber cabin and dark pines below the pale, steep face of the Matterhorn.
description: The last light on the ridge, seen from a clearing above Zermatt.

title: The Bridge of Sighs
alt: A white stone bridge spans a narrow Venetian canal above gondolas in deep shadow.
description: A strip of sky and an enclosed bridge divide the sunlit and shaded walls.

title: Boats off Bellagio
alt: Boats float on still blue water beneath a tree framing Bellagio and the mountains beyond.
description: Seen through the branches, the distant shore takes on the scale of a miniature.
